name: aux-sticky
description: Auto-switch variant that also stops the unit releasing AUX when the signal disappears. Removes the GetMediaDevice bail-out (so activation can happen) AND turns the 'signal absent' path into a no-op, so once AUX has been activated it stays selected until the user changes source. Useful if CarPlay audio is intermittent and the unit flaps between AUX and radio. CANDIDATE - not validated on hardware; the release path is deliberately disabled, so AUX will not hand back to radio on its own.

handlear +0x118: when the AUX signal is absent, jump to the return path instead of the release branch (sticky AUX)
